seeds_per_role._why: a decisive arm is the only one where a null is informative, so it is the only one worth spending seeds on. 3 seeds takes the minimum detectable effect from ~0.019 to ~0.016, which is the difference between train_lower_layers_soft (+0.020) being resolvable and not. An exploratory arm cannot be resolved by more seeds -- its expected effect is below the noise at any budget this machine can afford -- so extra seeds there buy nothing but cost an arm each.
